routes.name: Temporary Residence Permit
routes.summary: Lithuania issues a temporary residence permit for set purposes like work, study or family. Each permit is valid for the period printed on the card. Official details per purpose are on migracija.lrv.lt.

other: Specific grounds, durations and fees were not readable on the official pages (the site blocks automated access). Check the Migration Department before applying.

Since 2024, applicants must show means of subsistence of EUR 924 per month, for one year or the permit period if shorter. No separate proof is needed if you work legally and earn at least one minimum monthly salary.

routes.name: EU Blue Card (highly qualified employee)
routes.summary: Residence permit for highly qualified employees. Applicants can start the highly qualified job from the date the Migration Department gets the application.

other: Salary threshold, qualification rules and duration could not be read on an official page. Check the Migration Department.
The Employment Service may need to confirm the job meets labor market needs.

sources.label: Migration Department: changes for foreigners who work (March 2021)

routes.name: Temporary residence permit for study graduates
routes.summary: People who finish studies in Lithuania can get a permit to stay and work. Master's and doctoral students and graduates can work without the 20 hours per week cap.

other: Must have completed studies in Lithuania on a temporary residence permit.
Length of the graduate permit and other conditions not confirmed on an official page.

sources.label: Migration Department: changes for foreigners who work (March 2021)

routes.name: Permanent Residence Permit (long-term EU resident)
routes.summary: Lets a non-citizen live in Lithuania long term. It is issued as a long-term resident EU permit with a chip card.

other: Years of residence, language and income requirements were not readable on an official page. The 5 years in the link from the temporary permit is the usual EU rule, not confirmed here.

routes.name: Residence card of a family member of an EU citizen
routes.summary: Non-EU family members of an EU citizen get a residence card (temporary or permanent) in Lithuania.

other: Which relatives qualify and the documents needed were not read on an official page.

routes.name: Asylum
routes.summary: Asylum applications can be filed at a border checkpoint, or at the Migration Department if you entered legally. Crossing the border illegally is a crime.
